news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹10.53 (vs ₹9.17 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.53 (up from ₹9.17 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.90b (up 29% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹132.9m (up 15% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.0% (down from 7.9% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 11% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (11% average weekly change).

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 27%
news.body: After last week's 27% share price gain to ₹63.10, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 5.5x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Construction industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 13% over the past year.
